reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Never take admission here.

review_content.Placements: I am deeply disappointed with the placement opportunities provided by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University. Despite promises made during admission regarding good corporate tie ups and regular placement drives the reality is far from expectations. The placement cell is inactive and the promises made during admission about 100 percent placement are completely false. No soft skill training interview prep or resume building sessions are provided.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus is okay but nothing exceptional. Some buildings are new but maintenance is poor. Classrooms lack proper equipment and the library is average. Fake promises are made during admission.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: I advise students not to take admission here. The atmosphere of the college is very bad.

review_content.Placements: As a student of this college, I feel it is important to share an honest review of the placement scenario here. Unfortunately, the placement situation is far from what is promised during admission. The college tends to exaggerate the number and quality of companies visiting the college. In reality, only a handful of companies come for recruitment.
review_content.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure of my college is quite disappointing and does not meet the basic standard expected from a reputed university. Apart from the admission area, which is well-maintained to create a good first impression for new students and parents. The rest of the campus lacks proper care and development.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Faculty members are very supportive and helpful.

review_content.Placements: Many companies recruit students from the college like Axis Bank, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, etc. The highest package is 8 LPA. It has vast options in the placement cell, and the placement cell helps us with placements. It gives better opportunities and gives valuable knowledge to pass through every interview.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is well-built with a library. The hostel is near the main college building. It has a basketball court and a badminton court. The hostel is very good with AC service and Wi-Fi services. It has nice food in the hostel mess. It has 2 canteens and juice centers. Labs are well-equipped and classrooms are all air-conditioned.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: The college has good infrastructure,

review_content.Placements: Approximately 73% of students received placement offers, with an average salary package of 4 LPA. The highest salary package reached up to 18 lakhs. Top recruiters included Wipro, TCS, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Amazon, Reliance, Airtel, Godrej, Aditya Birla Group, JSW, ITC, and Microsoft.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped, and some are equipped with air conditioning, modern labs with the necessary equipment. For practical sessions, a two-floor, fully air-conditioned library with a vast collection of books and digital resources, and high-speed internet. All over the campus, computer labs with high processing capacity systems.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Average students can take admission. The faculty is good but needs so much improvements.

review_content.Placements: Till now I haven't seen any kind of placement in our college. The college does not provide placements. It was established in 2018, so the college is not famous. They provide a platform for learning skills by IIT teachers and after that, we have to give an exam and we will get a certificate for the course. All kinds of IT work and development roles are provided.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is average as per other colleges. The college is still under construction so many things and changing. It has a huge playground, sports room, classrooms, and a good library. The college provided Wi-Fi on every floor. I don't live in a hostel but it's quite good as per my friends. The food is also average.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: I will give you my summary by giving my college a 4.5 star rating.

review_content.Placements: Almost 80 to 90% of students got placed but companies have their own terms and conditions. In my college, Infosys and Godrej are the top recruiting companies. All students get a chance for internships. I got the role of learning a done-making process.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in every area of my campus. There are 10 computer labs for CSE and IT department students. My college campus has a library for every department and one central library. There are 3 big canteens in my college with good quality and reasonable prices. It has medical facilities and a cricket ground and sports room too.

reviews.review_heading: Never take admission here.
reviews.review_text: The campus is okay but nothing exceptional. Some buildings are new but maintenance is poor. Classrooms lack proper equipment and the library is average. Fake promises are made during admission.

reviews.review_heading: I advise students not to take admission here. The atmosphere of the college is very bad.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of my college is quite disappointing and does not meet the basic standard expected from a reputed university. Apart from the admission area, which is well-maintained to create a good first impression for new students and parents. The rest of the campus lacks proper care and development.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are very supportive and helpful.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well-built with a library. The hostel is near the main college building. It has a basketball court and a badminton court. The hostel is very good with AC service and Wi-Fi services. It has nice food in the hostel mess. It has 2 canteens and juice centers. Labs are well-equipped and classrooms are all air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure,
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped, and some are equipped with air conditioning, modern labs with the necessary equipment. For practical sessions, a two-floor, fully air-conditioned library with a vast collection of books and digital resources, and high-speed internet. All over the campus, computer labs with high processing capacity systems.

reviews.review_heading: Average students can take admission. The faculty is good but needs so much improvements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is average as per other colleges. The college is still under construction so many things and changing. It has a huge playground, sports room, classrooms, and a good library. The college provided Wi-Fi on every floor. I don't live in a hostel but it's quite good as per my friends. The food is also average.

reviews.review_heading: I will give you my summary by giving my college a 4.5 star rating.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in every area of my campus. There are 10 computer labs for CSE and IT department students. My college campus has a library for every department and one central library. There are 3 big canteens in my college with good quality and reasonable prices. It has medical facilities and a cricket ground and sports room too.

reviews.review_heading: Campus chronicles- An honest take on Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University .
reviews.review_text: The teachers are available for assisting students in doubts regarding the topics. All the floors are equipped with Wi-Fi and library, and the classrooms are not fixed regularly for classes; it's random. The labs are not fully equipped with lab tools, and for experiments we have to bring the lab materials on our own. The hostel is within the campus and the facilities are only limited because of the poor management. The hospital is within the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the campus, faculty members, good placements, and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University is the best as the campus is huge, and the surroundings are beautiful, surrounded by mountains. Wi-Fi is also the best, set up on all floors. The library facility is the best, providing all the academic books you need.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very far and dissatisfying.
reviews.review_text: College has air-conditioned classrooms. Wi-Fi is not available in the college. Library is just for studies, not a lot of books are available and students mostly play games in library. Canteen has good food but it's always crowded and medical facility is very terrible.

reviews.review_heading: I must recommend taking the course. It is the best and affordable college with the best facilities.
reviews.review_text: Everything is available, and food is also good. Wi-Fi is available on the whole campus. There are two grounds for cricket and football, one ground for basketball, one ground for volleyball, and one badminton court. There are separate libraries for every department and a central library.

reviews.review_heading: It had good placements and faculty. Infrastructure was decent with scope for practical improvements.
reviews.review_text: BSc department has good infrastructure, including modern laboratories and large library. Classrooms were spacious but lacked air conditioning. Hostel facilities were decent with clean rooms and basic mess food. Medical support and sports facilities were available and helpful for students.

reviews.review_heading: All about Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University panel.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Wi-Fi is good, laptops are provided, and classrooms are well-equipped.Good quality facilities are available in hostel. Food is served in the mess and canteen and medical and sports are decent and very good.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend this college to someone who prefers a slow and steady lifestyle.
reviews.review_text: The college provides basic amenities like a canteen and hostel, where cleanliness is well maintained. College campus is also very clean. It offers basic internet facilities, including Wi-Fi across the campus, as well as essential tools and improvements needed for students.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college for college life. The faculty and crowd are good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. They have Wi-Fi on all floors. There is a good library, a sports room with many indoor games, and a cultural room. The hostel is nice. There are 2 canteens. One is air-conditioned, and the other is non-air-conditioned. We have a gym. Students can workout easily.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good infrastructure, college, and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good. There is a huge building and very good. It is beautiful and eco-friendly. It has a green nature. The college hostel is there. It is also good. The food is okay but not that much good. The college owns a hospital so we can have free checkups.

reviews.review_heading: MBBS at Akash Institute.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is good, clean, and hygienic. The food is tasty. The hostel fee also includes the mess fee. Wi-Fi is not available. The library is peaceful. Labs are well-built. The canteen has both veg and non-veg food. A sports ground is also present. A swimming pool is available.

reviews.review_heading: Life of MBBS student at Akash Group of Institutions.
reviews.review_text: The hostel fee is 1.5 lakh per year. The canteen fee is included. For non-veg food, we have to pay an extra fee. Wi-Fi is not available but classrooms are set up with AC. Few lecture halls are good. The canteen food is good. Sports are not available. Only during fests, there are sports competitions.

reviews.review_heading: MBBS life at Akash Institute.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, with all the lecture halls and practical demo rooms well-equipped. The library has a wide variety of books and is spacious with a peaceful environment. A cafeteria is present in the college, and the canteen is present in the hospital. A sports ground is available, and a swimming pool is also present.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Akash Group of Institutions.
reviews.review_text: Because there are not enough faculty members available, we will not be able to finish the syllabus on time. Department-wise, I am not sure, so I am only talking about MBA faculty. Hostel quality is not good because bed bugs are there and food quality is also not good so better choose a government hostel.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for academics but campus life is not good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good. Hostel facilities are decent. Our campus is not spacious. There is a playground on our campus. This college is still under construction. Management courses like MBA, BBA, and BCA have separate buildings.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent faculty and teaching and modern infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: We have very modern infrastructure and all facilities needed like libraries, classrooms and access to the hospital. We have a very good hostel facility, and the food quality is really nice, the hygiene maintained in the mess is also more than satisfactory. Being attached to a hospital, we have access to medical facilities 24/7, we have an hour of sports and games every day.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Akash Institute of Nursing Devanahalli.
reviews.review_text: The college is situated in Devanahalli which is very near Kempegowda International Airport. The college building is super with nice classrooms and labs. Wi-Fi is not available on campus. The hostel is inside the same compound. The hostel is good looking and facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: It provides good infrastructure, and the facilities are also excellent.
reviews.review_text: This college provides laboratories and classrooms. The library was clean and there was total silence. There were many books to read in the library, the laboratories were good, and students can try every experiment. The books which were given by Aakash were the best, and students can learn everything from them. The canteen was provided, and the food was very delicious.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a very good infrastructure and very good facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a very good infrastructure, along with neat labs and classrooms. There are neat hostel facilities with good Wi-Fi facility. Good quality food is served in the hostel, and the canteen is good with good food. Our college provides good sports with neat equipment and also good medical facilities with students-friendly staff members.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Akash Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Centre.
reviews.review_text: Lecture halls are quite good of 170 capacity. There are 4 lecture halls in the college and 1 in the hospital. Two of the lecture halls are air-conditioned. The building is not that great but well-equipped with labs, research labs, and demonstration rooms. The opportunities for sports is minimal. The canteen is fine. Medical facilities in some departments are good, but some needs improvement.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good infrastructure and education-wise facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good infrastructure. The college provides facilities like large building, spacious auditoriums, demo rooms, well-equipped labs, libraries, study places, common rooms and canteens. The college provides good hostel facility with good food and other facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good facilities and teaching staff members.
reviews.review_text: Our college got its own central library which is very informative and helpful. There is a Wi-Fi facility in the hostel but not in college. Labs are spacious and clean with good equipment. Hostel food is good, and they serve South Indian meals. The college has its canteen where you can get Chinese food. Medical facilities are excellent and effective. There is a huge ground for sports, and a basketball court and badminton court are available here.

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with our college infrastructure and teaching.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms and computer available here assist in learning. Classrooms are air-conditioned and are huge and can accommodate more than 200 students. They are also equipped with projectors. The library has books for subjects and also has a computer room for learning. There are good washrooms on all floors.

reviews.review_heading: Life at aimsrc medicos life.
reviews.review_text: We have gym in hostel. Library is very near to college with different kinds of books. We have very good playground with all kind of sport courts. Hostel is 3 sharing and 2 sharing with clean rooms and washrooms and hot water for batch. Mess food is very hygienic and tasty with evening snacks provided.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty with great facilities.
reviews.review_text: About the infrastructure is good. The college didn't provide transportation facilities, but the college is near to auto and bus stand we can easily travel from there. Different blocks are there for each department. Low-priced canteen with good food. No playing time.

reviews.review_heading: Okay faculty, good placements, nice environment & facilities.
reviews.review_text: College is providing Computer labs, library, seminar hall, auditorium, spacious ground, few trees with place to sit and relax. No hostel service but there are few near by. Canteen is good. And there are famous tiffin center, shops with variety of food items near the college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college does not have good value for money.
reviews.review_text: Our labs are newly installed.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good and worth the money.
reviews.review_text: College does not have any hostel and canteen. Library is available but has no Wi-Fi for students. Labs and classrooms are available for students and staff has a room at the gate. Some sports are held once a year. Canteen is not available for students and staff.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good with less fee.
reviews.review_text: Computer science is the best course. Classrooms are spacious and big. Wi-Fi is available on every floor. Every department has different labs. Science department lab is big and well equipped.

reviews.review_heading: College is great and faculty members are excellent but the placements are totally worst.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is quite good. All the classrooms are near and clean. The college consists of a library and reading rooms for girls and boys. There are a number of classrooms and divided blocks for B.Sc., B.Com, BBA, MBA, M.Com, etc. There is sufficient space for parking.

reviews.review_heading: It provides the best faculty members for students.
reviews.review_text: In this college, it provides high-speed Wi-Fi up to the 3rd floor. The library was near the office, but students do not have a particular place like a study hall and there was no space to study in the library. Students need to register for every single book and only 3 books were permitted. The hostel facility was not available, but students can find some in the nearby areas.

reviews.review_heading: This is an average college because everything is low.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was fine and the ground area was also fine. The parking was also good, and the sitting area was also good. The classrooms were big enough. The quality of food in the mess was average, but the medical facilities were good. The sports and activities were also good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely a good college to learn everything.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in our college are very good l, we got some of the best lectures, labs are very good and big we got a big library and we got all books in our library, Hostels are very good and clean, canteen is good as we spend more time in our canteen, we have many sport activities and NCC training in our college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with all facilities, and also financially average for students.
reviews.review_text: Our college has laboratories, a library, seminar hall, auditorium which are very helpful to the students. A canteen is available, sports-related are available to the students. NCC is also available. Every place is neat and eco-friendly. College surroundings are also very clean and healthy.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for education.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities. The infrastructure is excellent here. There is a Wi-Fi connection for office use. Labs are well-equipped with all apparatus and materials. Classrooms have all facilities and air-conditioners. There is a library with all kinds of books. There is a playground also which is very good and mainly used for NCC students. The parking facility is also good. It provides appropriate classrooms for learning and practicals. Projectors are only available in labs.

reviews.review_heading: It is a nearly 50 years old college, which is run by a Marwadi trust.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel facility. But it is a good degree college. It provides good facilities. It provides a physics lab, maths lab, and computer lab. It has a good and the largest library where many students study.

reviews.review_heading: It is an affordable college with great staff and a peaceful ambiance.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is great. It has everything that a college needs, like a computer lab, audio-visual lab, auditorium, canteen, library etc. It also has Wi-Fi. Cleanliness and hygiene are well maintained in college. The college is active in extracurricular activities. The college doesn't have a hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good because of dedicated faculty.
reviews.review_text: High-speed Wi-Fi upto 3rd floor. We also have library near the office but we don't have a particular place like study hall and there's no space to study in the library. We need to register for every single book and only 3books are permitted. We don't have hostel in our college but we can find some in the nearby areas.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very nice college with all facilities like labs, libraries and experienced faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very nice here, and the infrastructure is also excellent here. The department provides very good facilities like Wi-Fi connection for office use, labs with all apparatus and materials and classrooms with all facilities and air-conditioners. There is a library with all kinds of books.

review_summary.college_name: DPG Degree College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Mathematics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college with good infrastructure and placement. In my opinion, you can go with this.

content.Placements: From this year onwards, DPG College is focusing on placement. The highest package is 15 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. The top recruiting companies here are Albamay and Triple Solution Limited. At least 70% of students from each batch get placed here. The top roles here are customer support, sales, and accounting.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities here are very good they always support you in your studies always try to resolve your doubt there is specific library for UG students and specific for PG students and in classroom white boaed are there classes are hitech Hostel are also good food is also good infrastructure wise the building is quite new.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Building and infrastructure are good. Study is also good with a good environment.

content.Placements: I am still not sure about the placement because my batch is the second batch in B.Tech. There is no batch of B.Tech that has graduated and been placed. HOD of our department has ensured that they will bring companies during placement, and the companies will be mostly that they bring for B.Sc. placement like Infosys, Cognizant, or nearby companies. The average package you can expect is 3 LPA - 4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Building facilities are good. They have Wi-Fi in every building but the point is that students do not have access to Wi-Fi. Classrooms are big enough. One building is newly built so it is still in the development phase. Sports facilities are also available, and they organize sports competitions. I don't know about hostel and mess facilities because I am a day scholar.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Average teaching, decent facilities, average crowd, but the curriculum and placements need work.

content.Placements: Placements in our course were modest, with about 25% of students getting placed. Salary packages range from Rs.11,000 to Rs.18,000 per month, average of Rs.15,000. Maruti Suzuki India Limited was the top recruiter, mainly offering HR roles. Overall, placements need improvement.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available on campus. The labs are normal and equipped for practical learning. Classrooms are air-conditioned, clean, and well-maintained. The library has all the required books and reference materials. Medical facilities are available on campus, and there are also facilities for sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great learning environment with strong placements and modern infrastructure - worth the investment.

content.Placements: Placement started in the final year. Major recruiters are TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and HCL. Average package is 3.5 LPA. The highest package is 6 LPA. Placement support is good. Regular training and mock interviews are conducted.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are clean and equipped with projectors and whiteboards. Computer labs are well-maintained with good internet connectivity. Library has a decent collection of books related to the course and current affairs. Hostel is decent. Rooms are spacious, and food quality is average. Wi-Fi is available but limited to certain timings.

individual_reviews.course: Masters in Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is a helpful college for the middle-class family.

content.Placements: A minimum of 60% of students got placed. The highest package is 8 lacs, and the lowest package ranges from 2 to 3 lacs. The average package is 3 to 4 lacs. Top recruiters include Amul and Airtel. 60% of students secured internships, with top roles offered including HR, manager, accountant, businessman, businesswoman, and entrepreneur. They provide innovative ways to develop skills such as emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills. There are many tips for managing personal and professional life.
content.Infrastructure: Classes are smart, air-conditioned, punctual, and helpful in guiding students, with strict rules against illegal activities like ragging. Regular exams are conducted to assess the students' IQ levels, and sessional exams are of good quality. There are plenty of sports activities and other cultural programs.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good infrastructure and placement. In my opinion, you can go with this.
reviews.review_text:

Hostel are also good food is also good infrastructure wise the building is quite new.

reviews.review_heading: Building and infrastructure are good. Study is also good with a good environment.
reviews.review_text: Building facilities are good. They have Wi-Fi in every building but the point is that students do not have access to Wi-Fi. Classrooms are big enough. One building is newly built so it is still in the development phase. Sports facilities are also available, and they organize sports competitions. I don't know about hostel and mess facilities because I am a day scholar.

reviews.review_heading: Average teaching, decent facilities, average crowd, but the curriculum and placements need work.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on campus. The labs are normal and equipped for practical learning. Classrooms are air-conditioned, clean, and well-maintained. The library has all the required books and reference materials. Medical facilities are available on campus, and there are also facilities for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Great learning environment with strong placements and modern infrastructure - worth the investment.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are clean and equipped with projectors and whiteboards. Computer labs are well-maintained with good internet connectivity. Library has a decent collection of books related to the course and current affairs. Hostel is decent. Rooms are spacious, and food quality is average. Wi-Fi is available but limited to certain timings.

reviews.review_heading: It is a helpful college for the middle-class family.
reviews.review_text: Classes are smart, air-conditioned, punctual, and helpful in guiding students, with strict rules against illegal activities like ragging. Regular exams are conducted to assess the students' IQ levels, and sessional exams are of good quality. There are plenty of sports activities and other cultural programs.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely unhappy because of the campus life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure rate is 2/5. The classrooms are okay but not very modern. Wi-Fi is available but often slow. Computer labs have outdated systems, and sometimes not all systems work properly. Library is decent but lacks updated books for BCA. Hostel facilities are average. Rooms are basic, and cleanliness is sometimes an issue. The mess food is repetitive and not very tasty. Canteen is small with limited options. Medical support is available but not very quickly. Sports facilities are minimal, mos...

reviews.review_heading: Review of DPG Degree College - DPGDC.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good. The campus is also nice and spacious. Parking for two-wheelers is available for students. If students have a car, then the guard will stop them near the gate and he will say don't enter with a car and park it out of the campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is better than expectations. The infrastructure is also good.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good. It has a hygienic canteen and labs are well-organised. Teachers always motivate us to go to the lab and learn new things. Students get free Wi-Fi, and all students have a password for Wi-Fi, so we can access it anytime, and the speed is good. Classrooms are very hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Good for students who want to pursue B.Tech but don't have many sources. Must for degree.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are better than expected, as all have AC. All the classrooms have a smartboard. All floor has separate washrooms for boys and girls. The floor has an RO machine for water. Talking about college canteen, it is good and affordable. Hostel food and mess are mind-blowing.

reviews.review_heading: Review of DPG Degree College - DPGDC.
reviews.review_text: DPG Degree College is one of the top BBA colleges in Gurugram. The food served is good in the canteen to eat and hygiene is properly maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements are provided by the college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are available for students, with fully ventilated and clean rooms. Sports and games are provided for both college and hostel students. The canteen serves food for both day scholars and hostel residents.

reviews.review_heading: This is my honest review of our college.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a hostel facility. Infrastructure of the college and hostel is very good. Hostel has a food and Wi-Fi facility. Hostel food is average. There is no facility for sports.

reviews.review_heading: Yes, all things are too good.
reviews.review_text: Our college has all the facilities like AC classes, computer classes, library, labs, guest rooms, a good environment, and free Wi-Fi. According to me, everything is good, apart from some minor shortcomings, which you will find everywhere. The highest package is 9.8 LPA and the lowest package is 3.6 LPA. Our teachers are also very helpful. They help us a lot with any problems and also support us. They also organize a lot of activities and go on tours, etc.

reviews.review_heading: My experience about DPG degree college .
reviews.review_text: Firstly, the network quality of the area where the college is situated is very low. Although there are Wi-Fis all over the college, students are not allowed to use them. Also, there are jammers placed in certain places, due to which we are not even able to do anything important if needed. Hostel and mess facilities are very average. The food does taste well.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty and good infrastructure .
reviews.review_text:
Free Wi-Fi, computer labs, an AC campus, and a library with every type of book are available for my course.
Multiple canteens are there for students to eat and sit to gossip during break times. 
Good parking spaces are available. 
Bus facilities are there for students.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall, best college for M.Sc. in chemistry course.

content.Placements: Placements are good as last year's statistics. About 96% of students got placed. There is scope for core as well. For people interested in research, you will have a good foundation built here. The student community is very supportive and supportive of each other during transfers. Average package is also good, around 10 LPA - 15 LPA. Many students received their internships as well.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has air-conditioned lecture halls, separate labs for dedicated research, and centralized Wi-Fi throughout the campus. Hostel facilities provide everything that is needed for the stay. It is well-equipped and good. We also have hygiene facilities. Mess food is also decent and good enough. There is a kitchen in each hotel with showers. We have sports facilities in each hotel with a dedicated area and ground for each sport.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Botany - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall best college for M.Sc. In the Botany Course.

content.Placements: More than 72% of students are placed on campus. More than 70% of placements occurred within the first 2 weeks of placement. The average bid was around 11 LPA. The companies spanned from core like ICAR, IARI, Patanjali, etc. Top roles offered are Environment Consultant, Horticulturist, etc. About 65% of students get their internships.
content.Infrastructure: Fast Wi-Fi is accessible all over campus. The lecture rooms are extensive and feature large sofas for the instructors. The library is where students gather to prepare for major exams and quizzes, and it gets crowded. Hotels are affordable, though certain areas have plumbing problems. Athletic facilities are also available in the neighborhoods.

individual_reviews.course: M.Phil. in Mathematics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is a decent college for placements.

content.Placements: Only 50% of students got placed through our college. The average salary package in our course is 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are McKinsey, JP Morgan, PwC, etc. The placement cell is decent and not so helpful. Mostly, top students got opportunities for internships.
content.Infrastructure: It has great infrastructure with a good environment. The college has a video library to support film studies. The college offers well-cleaned classrooms, a library, and Wi-Fi-enabled areas. The canteen of the hostel is good. Veg, non-veg, and all types of foods are available.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Economics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall best college for M.A. in Economics Course.

content.Placements: 75 percent of students enrolled in this study. The highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest package is 3 LPA and the average package is 6 LPA. 70 percent of the top recruiting companies are Amazon, Google, Genpact, etc. I got internships from my studies. They offer high-level roles like data analyst, market research analyst and more.
content.Infrastructure: The campus covers an area of 700 acres. It resembles paradise, given the Chennai skyline. It is the top college among all colleges. Encircled by woods and animals. The infrastructure is satisfactory. The quality of laboratories and classrooms is excellent. A few of the hostels are outdated, but that's fine. Certain locations lacked adequate amenities. Nonetheless, the food quality is satisfactory. The cost incurred is Rs. 85 daily.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: This is the best college for the M.Sc. in Physics course.

content.Placements: About 77% of enrollees got placed from our course, and the good thing about those placements was that almost 60% went into a core field, which was a very good number. The highest salary offered was 16 LPA, and the average salary offered was 10 LPA. Top recruiters are Infosys, Wipro, TCS, etc. Almost every student gets an internship opportunity.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and amenities of our college are top-notch. The hostel has many facilities like indoor and outdoor sports, and musical instruments separately for any hostel. Wi-Fi is available with very good internet speed. Classrooms have all the required facilities. The library is air-conditioned and quite large. The mess has a special menu for all 7 days. The institute hospital is free.

reviews.review_text: There was a huge library the size of a football stadium with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and adequate sanitation. The classrooms were spotless. Hostel mess is different for northern region and southern students, as the food types are different.

reviews.review_text: Our organizational structure in every library lecture hall and department room is of a higher standard and better than most old private colleges and institutions. The food is well-balanced with occasional fruits and sweets.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best college for the M.Sc. in Physics course.
reviews.review_text: Our college is among the oldest institutions in India. Facilities are basic, and the college provides its own Wi-Fi network to aid in browsing. Every classroom has a projector to enhance student comprehension. Our college dining hall features a well-known eatery, and the cuisine is excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best college for the M.Sc. in Physics course.
reviews.review_text: The hotel is excellent, with all the basic amenities here, and the quality of the mess food and the amazing taste are something that could be improved. Also, medical facilities are readily available here, and that is good too. Many sports and competitions are often held to keep the students energized and happy.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best college for M.Sc. in physics course.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well ventilated and kept clean, and the food is clean and vegetarian. There are 3 grounds, but you will only be allowed to enter one, and the others are for international students. The chaos offers two types of food, one for regular meals and the other for international students, as Indian cuisine will not change.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are constructed on a separate block and have all the basic facilities like clean washrooms, a hygienic environment, rooms equipped with a bed, study table, AC or cooler, and a cupboard. The infrastructure is nice with a beautiful garden and playgrounds. The mess and canteen have delicious and healthy food. There is strict surveillance on studies. Canteen food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best college for the MCA course.
reviews.review_text: On campus, Wi-Fi is provided, although it might not function in some areas. There are two hostels for males. One is in poor condition, and the other is an old PG hostel. The PG hostel has top-notch features and is of the highest quality. The food has no value. Medical centers are available in the college at specific times. Two boys’ mess facilities are available. Sports and games are also provided within the campus.

reviews.review_heading: My first reaction to this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college has quite average infrastructure. Labs are huge and very old. Classrooms are cleaned and equipped with windows, AC, and projectors. The food at the hostel is not so good. Many sports facilities are available like table tennis, volleyball, badminton, etc.

faqs.answer: In order to get admission to MBA at RA Podar Institute of Management, candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place. faqs.question: Is MBA available at RA Podar Institute of Management?
faqs.answer: A full-time MBA course is offered at RA Podar Institute of Management. Apart from the MBA (General) course, the institute also offers MBA in Service Management. faqs.question: Is there any entrance exam for E-MBA course at RA Podar Institute of Management?

faqs.answer: The selection process for admission to various courses at RA Podar Institute of Management includeswritten tests, group discussion rounds, and personal interview rounds. faqs.question: Which courses are offered by RA Podar Institute of Management?
faqs.answer: Candidates willing to get admission to various courses must apply online on the official website of RA Podar Institute of Management. faqs.question: Is any other entrance scores accepted for admission at R.A Podar Institute of Management?
faqs.answer: No, candidates with any other national/state management entrance test score will not be considered for shortlisting. Candidates will be required to appear for PIM MAT (R.A Podar Institute of Management-Management Aptitude Test ). They cannot use their other management entrance test scores as an alternative to PIM MAT for the admission process. This means that candidates will have to appear for PIM MAT that meets the admission criteria for the MBA programme at R.A Podar Institute of Management.PIM MAT is expected to held in second week of June 2026. overview_faqs.question: Is APSU, Rewa a good university for MBA?

overview_faqs.question: What is the application fee for BCom at APSU?
overview_faqs.answer: The application fee for BCom at Awadhesh Pratap Singh University (APSU) is NR 600 for General/OBC candidates and INR 400 for SC/ST (M.P. Domicile) candidates. Candidates must pay the fee, along with application form.Candidates have two options to submit their admi ssion form - either through the MP Online kiosk or the MP Online Portal from their home. review_summary.college_name: APSU Rewa Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Chemistry - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: For my college, according to that place, it is not that much good.

content.Placements: Approximately 60 percent of students were placed. The highest package was 72,000 and the lowest was 12,000. Very less students got internships. Recruitment is done by educational institutions only; no companies come on campus. You can go for interviews and job-related enquiries to other places. Top roles are for teaching lines.
content.Infrastructure: Lab is available in the college and we attend lab class every Tuesday, but the lab condition is not that good to do practicals there as there are no safety measures. Classes were also not in good condition. There is a high need for maintenance of benches, fans, doors, blackboard etc. The smart classroom is a little bit in good condition.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Facility for study in college is good compared to the nearest colleges.

content.Placements: The percentage is in mass where 50 -60 students are placed in companies like Ultratech, and some other companies. Top recruiters are Ultratech, Accenture, KJS Cement, and in the CSE branch, all students are placed. The average package is 2.2 LPA and the highest is 5.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is average but sports and games are held on campus, and all sports are held, like volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, swimming, table tennis, and running. Medical facilities are also available on campus and a canteen is available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Decent university with a balance of everything.

content.Placements: Approximately 60-70% of BBA students get placed through campus recruitment. The highest package offered is around 5 LPA, the lowest is 2.5 LPA, and the average is 3.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies include HCL, TCS, ICICI, and Infosys. Around 50% of students secure internships in companies such as ICICI, HDFC, and local SMEs. Popular roles offered include business analyst, marketing executive, sales executive, and HR Trainee.
content.Infrastructure: The university provides a vibrant campus with a comfortable, spacious classroom environment. It has a computer laboratory and a library full of management and business books, which helps increase the knowledge of the students. It also organizes a management fest and other activities every year.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A door to success of your dream.

content.Placements: There are campus placements in my college in fact there is no campus placement in the whole university, if you want placement you have to apply privately. No student got internships also what would I say if there were no placements and internships.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities in my college are average. There are no sports activities, no smart classes, and no Wi-Fi. There is only an offline college which is enough for your knowledge and it also has a library from which you take books for respective courses and labs are also there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the college because of the faculty, facilities, friends, and good teachers.

content.Placements: Since it is a government college, it has low chances to get placements from this college. If we want placement then we have to get it on our own efforts. The college provides internship programs for students to earn experience, which is the best thing about college.
content.Infrastructure: My college does not have a large infrastructure or building. It has all the necessary facilities like a water cooler, classrooms, library, sports ground, etc. I am not in the hostel because my house is near the college. I heard that the hostel facilities are also good.

admission_overview.title: APSU Admissions Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: APSU admissions process 2025 is based on the candidate’s academic merits followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interviews except few programmes. The admission process is based on both online (MPONLINE) and offline. To be eligible for APSU admission, candidates must have 50% in Class 12 and graduation for UG and PG programmes respectively. Awadhesh Pratap Singh University (APSU Rewa) offers full-time more than 9 UG level programmes in 11 specialisations and nine PG programmes in 18 specialisations. Admission to BEd and BPEd courses is based on counselling conducted by the Madhya Pradesh, higher education department and MBA admission is granted on the basis of entrance exam CMAT/CAT.

admission_process.title: APSU Admissions Process 2025

paragraphs: Awadhesh Pratap Singh University is open for admission. Students applying for admission need to meet certain requirements and score well in past academic sessions. Admission to university courses will be online through the ONLINE portal. Follow the below step-by-step APSU admission process:
Step 1: Awadhesh Pratap Singh University Application: Fill out an APSU application form with required documents on apsurewa.ac.in or apsu.mponline.gov.in
Step 2: Awadhesh Pratap Singh University Selection: Selection is done on the basis of performance in previous academic exams and students will receive admission letter from APSU.
Step 3: Verification: Accept the offer letter and provide important papers for verify the certificate.
Step 4: Fee Payment: To finish getting into APSU, pay the fees for the chosen course.
Note: Candidates are required to submit the printout of admission form along with the photocopies of the mark sheets and other required documents based on category.
APSU Affiliated Colleges

Awadhesh Pratap Singh University aims to provide knowledgeable education through effective teaching and research activities to build up skills and expertise within the students. The university has its official APSU placement cell and most of the students get job opportunities outside the campus through their skills and expertise. admission_process.title: Sardar Vallabhbhai Global University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Sardar Vallabhbhai Global University admission 2025is currently open. The university offers full-time courses, such as BTech, BCA, MBA, etc., at the UG and PG level. The university also offers doctorate-level courses besides the UG and PG courses. To be admitted toSardar Vallabhbhai Global University, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the university. Overall, the university offers nine courses (excluding specialisations) in various streams such as Engineering, Computer Application, Management, etc. The application process at Sardar Vallabhbhai Global University is conducted online. Read the following article to know more aboutSVGU course admission2025.

SVGU courses' admissions are based on entrance exam scores. Candidates must also fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements of the respective courses. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popularSardar Vallabhbhai Global University courses:
*Students having noMathematicsbackgroundshould undergo a bridge course offered by the University.
Sardar Vallabhbhai Global University admission process includes registration and entrance exam scores as per respective courses. Candidates must follow the below steps to get a seat in SVGU:
STEP 1:Sardar Vallabhbhai Global University Application Process 2025

Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the university for all courses expect PhD. Students who are looking for PhD course admission, need to apply offline. Aspirants can download the application form from the official website. The application fee for PhD course at Sardar Vallabhbhai Global University is INR 1,500.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds
Students will be selected based on JEE Main, GUJCET, Merit-based, CMAT or written test and research proposal presentation, UGC NET, CSIR NET, and SLET/ MPhil as per respective courses.
STEP 3: Merit List andAdmission Confirmation
Once selection rounds are over, the institute releases a merit list. To allot and confirm the seat candidates are required to pay the application fee at the admission receipt centre.

faqs.answer: PES College of Engineering has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses: CoursesEligibilityB.E. / B.TechCandidate must have passed Diploma in EngineeringM.E./M.TechCandidates must have passed qualifying examination or equivalent examination as prescribed by the Competent Authority and obtained an aggregate minimum of 50% marks (45% of marks in case of SC, ST and Category-I candidates) taken together in all the subjects of all the years/ semesters of the Degree Examination from any recognised institute/university. Final year students can also apply on provisional basis. Candidates must have valid GATE score.MBA/PGDMCandidates must have passed Bachelor's degree of minimum of 3 years duration examination or equivalent and obtained an aggregate minimum of 50% marks (45% of marks in case of SC, ST and Category-I of Karnataka candidates). Final year students can also apply on provisional basis.MCACandidate must have passed any recognised BCA / Bachelor degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent degree and obtained an aggregate minimum of 50% marks (45% of marks in case of SC, ST and Category-I of Karnataka candidates) taken together in all the subjects in all the years of the Degree Examination from any recognised institute/university. OR Candidate must have passed B.Sc. / B.Com / B.A. with Mathematics at 10 + 2 level or at Graduation level (with additional bridge courses as per the norms of the concerned University) and obtained an aggregate minimum of 50% marks (45% of marks in case of SC, ST and Category-I of Karnataka candidates) taken together in all the subjects in all the years of the Degree Examination from any recognised institute/university. Final year students can also apply on provisional basis.

review_summary.college_name: PES College of Engineering Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My journey with PESCE family.

content.Placements: As our college is an autonomous college affiliated with VTU. We have many campus placements as there will be more companies coming to our college to pick students for their companies. Our college has a very good placement history in the core and IT sectors too. But they will train us very well to make sure that we get placed in a good company by training us.
content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is the best. We have good hostel facilities and security system for students. We have Free Wi-Fi supply for students in the hostel. Our labs are well maintained and have well advanced equipment for the purpose of studies and practice. We have a good library facility too. Our library has a very good collection of books.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: People are good in my college, but the faculty members are very poor at explaining.

content.Placements: The placement is very low, and those who get placed get placed at 3.5 to 5 LPA. The best packages go for like 8 to 10 LPA, which is not so good. Infosys, Accenture, Capgemini, Cognizant, and TCS are the main companies involved. There is a very low percentage of students who get real internships; most of them get them in their last year, just because. The students who get internships are the ones who get it based on their skills and themselves through the connections they make at events. SDE, UI/UX Developer, and Data Science will be offered when we graduate.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Life in PES College of Engineering, Mandya.

content.Placements: As in any college, the number of placements has decreased in our college too, still there are a few who are getting placed in good companies like Capgemini. Many are placed in TCS and many more. Placement department is conducting new programs like Super 100, iOS training, and many more programs to train students for placements.
content.Infrastructure: Department is good the intake is 60 per year in ISE, and facilities are also good. Wi-Fi facility is provided throughout our campus, little problem with it in the hostel. Library is also good, we can take 3 books from there at a time. Canteen is average. Hostel is not so good for non-native students because most of the dishes are local food itself, and the rooms are average.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college has good placements and is well-maintained.

content.Placements: I think it may be 100%. The highest package is 40 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA. The top recruiting companies include Infosys, MNCs, etc. Around 70% get placed in internships. The top roles offered are in Robotics, VLSI, and Embedded Systems. Students who get placed in this course have high-paying jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities in our department are good. The classrooms are well-maintained. Labs are well-established. The hostel is also good, but the food is not as much as I want. The sports facilities are very good. The canteen on campus is well-maintained. We also have medical facilities in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am thankful to our college for allowing us to participate in technical events.

content.Placements: The top role offered in our college is software development. Recently, the highest package is 21 LPA. The average salary package is about 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Tricon, IBM, Capgemini, Accenture, and Cognizant. Around 80% of students got placed in our college.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is quite old but it is improving now. In washrooms, the cleanliness is bad. The canteen facility is also not good. The hostel facility is worth the money but the food is quite bad in the afternoon time. There are no medical facilities in the college.

description: PES College of Engineering cutoff 2025 is available on this page for admission to several UG & PG courses. Candidates can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the course, exam, round and category-wise cutoff details. Further exam-related updates are below:

PES College of Engineering Karnataka PGCET cutoff 2025 was concluded with the release of the final cutoff list. For admission to the MBA/PGDM course, the last round cutoff rank was 30734 in the General AI category.

Karnataka PGCET is the accepting exam for MBA/PGDM admission at PES College of Engineering. In 2025, the last round cutoff for MBA/PGDM admission was 30734 in the General category under the AI quota. In 2024, the cutoff rank for the same course was 12295, while in 2023, it was 17367.
For more categories, rounds, and quotas, candidates can use the provided filters to view the cutoffs.
Candidates preparing for 2026 admission can refer to the table below to view some of the important dates related to Karnataka PGCET 2026.

PES College of Engineering accepts Karnataka PGCET entrance exam scores for admission to the MBA/PGDM courses. Candidates can refer to the table below to check out the consolidated year-wise Karnataka PGCET cutoff lists.

As per the KCET last-round cutoff 2025 for B.E. / B.Tech admission, B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) has the lowest cutoff rank of 33313 for the General AI quota. The lower cutoff rank indicates strong competition for admission.
In 2024, the last round cutoff for the same specialisation was 35365, in the General All India quota.

According to the PES College of Engineering B.E. / B.Tech Cutoff 2025, the closing rank for B.Tech. in Robotics & Artificial Intelligence stood at 49355 among the students belonging to the General AI quota.

For the HS quota, the cutoff rank for the same specialisation was 43815. Comparing both the quotas, the last round cutoff rank for General AI category students was less competitive for admission than the HS quota students.

reviews.review_heading: My journey with PESCE family.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is the best. We have good hostel facilities and security system for students. We have Free Wi-Fi supply for students in the hostel. Our labs are well maintained and have well advanced equipment for the purpose of studies and practice. We have a good library facility too. Our library has a very good collection of books.

reviews.review_heading: People are good in my college, but the faculty members are very poor at explaining.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi, labs, and a library, but they are not much use because they are just to clear your syllabus. However, there is a new lab with Mac machines, which are good, and we have done iOS classes there. The food is average for morning and afternoon, but very bad for night. Only 2 chapatis in the afternoon. The canteen is open till 5.

reviews.review_heading: Life in PES College of Engineering, Mandya.
reviews.review_text: Department is good the intake is 60 per year in ISE, and facilities are also good. Wi-Fi facility is provided throughout our campus, little problem with it in the hostel. Library is also good, we can take 3 books from there at a time. Canteen is average. Hostel is not so good for non-native students because most of the dishes are local food itself, and the rooms are average.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements and is well-maintained.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in our department are good. The classrooms are well-maintained. Labs are well-established. The hostel is also good, but the food is not as much as I want. The sports facilities are very good. The canteen on campus is well-maintained. We also have medical facilities in our college.

reviews.review_heading: I am thankful to our college for allowing us to participate in technical events.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is quite old but it is improving now. In washrooms, the cleanliness is bad. The canteen facility is also not good. The hostel facility is worth the money but the food is quite bad in the afternoon time. There are no medical facilities in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for average students.
reviews.review_text: The hostel offers Wi-Fi, which is 30GB/month, you can use it however you want. The classrooms are decent and library is well and open during college hours. Hostel facilities are good. Quality of food in mess and canteen is too good.

reviews.review_heading: Happy to be in this college I hope that I get placed in good company.
reviews.review_text: Well-maintained hostel and canteens. The food prepared is very hygienic and worth the price. When it comes to classrooms, they are well maintained with smart boards in each classroom. AC is also available in the labs. Library is very well-maintained with lots of useful books. It gives us a peaceful environment to concentrate on reading.

reviews.review_heading: 2024 pass out from PES College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Policies like insurance were arranged by the college and it was renewed every year by them. Social responsible clubs and students union, representative selection were encouraged by the college management. Classrooms are highly ventilated and spacious has the capacity to hold 200 students at a time.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college's greenery.
reviews.review_text: We have 5 to 6 lab rooms, and of course, a library where we can study and borrow books for reference. Moreover, the hostel is good and we can accommodate compared to others. Food is also good. For sports, we can participate in any activity. Everything is good here.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty members, when it comes to fees collection, they will be bit rude.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure. Our college is full of greenery. The people working love greenery could join our college. Faculty members are really good. During internals time, they will support below-average students to score good marks, and they support other activities like NSS and sports too.

reviews.review_heading: Average ratings for placement, infrastructure, and the overall course.
reviews.review_text: Industrial experience and other exposure were happened thrice in a year. Around 89% of students from the department of MCA succeeded by the placement drives. The highest salary package offered on campus drives was 17.5 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: Excellence in academic coaching.
reviews.review_text: Hostel circumstances are easy to accept for the freshers and the newcomers. We can approach the hostel in charge without any hesitation for all kinds of needs. The bus is fully air-conditioned, with two drivers who are experienced in the field of driving.

reviews.review_heading: Review of PES EC campus. It's the best college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms are also very good. They are well-furnished with digital learning available. Hostel is very nice and rooms are provided with all the necessary facilities. Food in the hostel mess is very nice and better than any other college. We can definitely like the food here. Wi-Fi is best and always constant.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college, but one has to work hard on their own to secure high packages.
reviews.review_text: Our college has well-developed infrastructure and practical laboratories are well-equipped, including the Chemistry lab, Physics lab, MATLAB lab, and CAED lab. All are well-maintained and we also have smart classes and well-equipped library. Hostel facilities are nice as well.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities .
reviews.review_text: Good classrooms and labs, a vast library, and also 24x7 Wi-Fi available in any corner of the campus. The quality of food available in the canteen is average. Medical assistance is available all the time. Sports grounds are very vast and beautiful anyone in need or anyone who needs to practice anytime, ground will be available.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL. B. (Hons) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Raw, real, natural- A real with no concealed things is shared.

content.Placements: 80 percent of students got placed from my course. The highest package is 72 LPA, the lowest is 2.0 LPA, and the average is 25 LPA in my course. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas and Co and Trilegal are the top recruiting companies. The percentage of students placed is 70 to 77 percent in the above-named companies and in Luthra and Luthra Law Offices, Indus Law, P&A Law Offices, etc. Roles offered are Advocates, advisory, legal firm, corporate lawyers, in-house counsel, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facility the university provides is great, with Wi-Fi availability, computer labs, big airy classrooms with big windows for ventilation, and comfortable chairs and tables. Library with different books up to more than 35000 books. The hostel provides geysers, RO water, attached washrooms, Wi-Fi, electricity 24/7, etc. Food quality is good, but the taste is average. The canteen is good, and it has different tastes from state to state. They have a dedicated facility, also. Sports are compulsory here for everyone, and a gym facility.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Great college with experienced faculty members, modern infrastructure, and vibrant campus events.

content.Placements: The college placement drive is impressive, with an average package of 5 LPA. The highest package offered is 72 LPA. Top recruiters like TCS, Deloitte, Accenture, Wipro, and HCL provided diverse and rewarding opportunities, reflecting strong industry connections.
content.Infrastructure: College has an amazing library from where you can take books during exam times, it also has a Wi-Fi facility. Hostel infrastructure is well-maintained, offering spacious rooms, reliable Wi-Fi, and essential amenities for comfortable stay. We have common areas, mess facilities, and cleanliness standards that contribute positively to student life on campus.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Placement record and infrastructure are very good, and the faculty members are also humble.

content.Placements: Our college placement record is above 90% every year. Here, the highest salary package is 25 LPA, and the starting salary package is 6-8 LPA. Apart from that, you get the best opportunities for various research. For higher studies, students get the opportunity to study within the country or abroad. Various reputed companies like TCS, Amazon, and Infosys visit the campus and offer jobs to many students through interviews.
content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is well-organized and eye-catching. The classrooms and labs here are bright and air-conditioned. In addition, there is a café area, gym center, and free Wi-Fi. There are sports fields and a large library that has many different types of books.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the best university for the MBA course.

content.Placements: Approximately 75% of the students at our university are enrolled in our course. The lowest wage provided is 4 LPA, while the highest salary is 27 LPA. Nearly 70% of students secure internships. Top positions are available in financial analysis, management consulting, etc. Among the top employers are Swiggy, IBM, Microsoft, and many more.
content.Infrastructure: You can gain access to the library, where you can find books. There are no restaurants. Sports and games happen once a month, along with other branches. It's like a tournament, but games don’t happen very often. The lab facilities are good, and you can gain the skills needed in labs.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: My choice of CMR University has been the best decision of my life.

content.Placements: In our course, 85% of students successfully secure placements, with the highest salary package reaching 14 LPA and the lowest at 6 LPA. The leading companies hiring from our program include Amazon, Infosys, IBM, and Wipro. Approximately 90% of students have obtained placements across various programs such as B.Tech, MBA, BBA, and BCA. The individuals who have been placed are employed in roles such as software developers, cloud engineers, full-stack developers, and others.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is excellent, and each classroom is equipped with smart boards. Regarding the library, there is a wide selection of books authored by highly experienced writers. Wi-Fi, laboratories, and a canteen are accessible. The food served in the hostel is of good quality. The canteen is well-kept, and nearly all students enjoy visiting it.

admission_process.title: Rama University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Rama University admissionis currentlyopenfor various UG & PG courses. The university offers several undergraduate, postgraduate & Integrated courses in the stream of Science, Law, Engineering, Science, etc. Rama University admissions are entrance-based. Admission to all the courses atRama Universityis done through a valid scores of candidates inRama University Entrance Test (RUET)for all the UG & PG courses. Additionally, the university also accepts valid scores ofCUET UG & CUET PGentrance exams for the respective courses. As per the Rama University admission process, the shortlisted candidates are called for anInterview round. At last, the final seats are allocated via a counselling process. The in-depth details around Rama University admission 2025 are explained in the article below.

Rama University accepts scores of various entrance exams for admission to all itsUG & PG courses, including CUET, RUET, NEET, etc. Candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements before applying for the respective courses. Check below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria related to Rama University course admission 2025:
Class 12 in PCM with 50% aggregate
UG degree in any stream with 50% aggregate from a recognised university
Class 12 in Commerce stream with 50% aggregate from a recognised board
Class 12 with 50% aggregate in PCM/ PCB
Class 12 with 50% aggregate
UG degree in BTech with 60% aggregate
Class 12 with 50% aggregate
Note:Candidates have to pay an additional one-time Registration Fee of INR 6,000 and a per semester-wise Examination Fee of INR 3,500.
Download:Rama University Fee Structure (2023-24)

The Rama University admission process 2025 is consists of multiple steps, including fulfilling the basic eligibility criteria, qualifying for the selection criteria and filling an application form. Check below the detailed process for Rama University Kanpur admission process:
Step 1: Application Process

Rama University application process is conducted in both online and offline modes. Candidates can either fill an online application form on the university's official website for their desired programme. However, the offline process is also valid at Rama University. Candidates can download the application form, fill it and submit it with a demand draft of INR 1,000 at the admission office of Rama University.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Rama University admission is entirely entrance-based for all the UG & PG courses. The university commonly conducts its in-house entrance exam, i.e., RUET for the selection of eligible candidates. However, candidates are also shortlisted based on scores of various national-level entrance exams such as CUET, NEET, etc. Later on, the final selection is based on the performance of candidates in a PI round.
Step 3: Counselling Process

At last, the selected candidates are called for a university-level counselling process. The final seat allotment is done during the counselling. Further, the selected candidates need to pay a certain fee as perRama University fee structureto confirm admission.

reviews.review_text: Hostel facility is as good as much. Infrastructure of hostel and college is good and comfortable. They provide us with a safe and ragging-free environment for each student who is a part of this university. Hostel food quality is also good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: In this college, I live my most beautiful years, making many friends.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Classrooms are good for students, and labs are too good. The library is available for students. The canteen and mess food are good and tasty. They maintain hygiene for students.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good, I got very good placement in 2015 and also got very good companies.
reviews.review_text: All types of facilities were available in the college, including lift facilities, Wi-Fi, filtered water, and good infrastructure. The college had very good faculty members who taught well and were very supportive, with help available at every place. The college was really good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Rama University.
reviews.review_text: There were many buildings and campus was beautiful. Hostel was available, and you could use free Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library. Hostel mess was very good every day and they provided different meals like breakfast, lunch, and dinner. There was balcony available and filtered water. Our campus was ragging free. There were two beds in every room.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Rama University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, laboratories, classrooms, and a library are available. There is no maintenance of anything. The quality of classrooms is okay. Students can also hang out in the mess and canteen area.

reviews.review_heading: Everyone can go through the review without error.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the faculty members area but only for the official and faculty staff. The quality of the food and facilities in hostels and university should be improved. Sports and games are only held annually. The chance of participation is very less.

reviews.review_heading: I got disappointment in the placement.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hostel is quite impressive and effective. The course I have selected at the university does not have many facilities. The highest package offered during RCAS Powered by Sunstone placements 2025 was INR 26 LPA , and the average package stood at INR 4.60 LPA .

The placement team of RCAS Powered by Sunstone keeps track of the dynamic changes taking place across the globe to ensure success with Sunstone’s placement-centric sessions, such as comprehensive interview preparation. The course curriculum of courses like MBA , BBA , BCA , and BTech includes an 8-month internship project that helps students learn the key concepts with a practical approach. Alongside this, 100% of scholarship opportunities are offered to the students. The ROI recorded was 63% higher.

Sunstone’s Placement Opportunity Program (POP) offers students access to 200+ assured placement opportunities, or a refund of their first-year tuition fee if placements don’t meet the commitment. To be eligible for POP, students must maintain a minimum average attendance of 70% across all credit and non-credit classes in every semester. They are also required to clear all examinations with a minimum score of 80% or equivalent CGPA, and must not have any backlogs. In addition, students must ensure that all fee payments are made as per the timeline outlined in the offer letter. Lastly, students must strictly adhere to the Sunstone Placement Policy Guidelines throughout the program

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Mathematics - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Nice experience here; true facts about my college.

content.Placements: After the 4th semester, students become eligible for campus placement. Overall, 85% of students get placements every year, and the college strives to make this percentage reach 100. The average package is 4-6 LPA, the highest package is around 26 LPA, and the lowest package is 2.5-3 LPA. Wipro, HCL, JSW, and TATA Consultancy are top recruiters.
content.Infrastructure: In the hostel room, they provide a table, chair, B.Ed cupboard, fan, and other items. Cleaning staff come daily to clean the rooms, washrooms, and corridors. There is a big library in the hostel. The food provided is very delicious and healthy. Guards and CCTV cameras are present in the hostel for student security. There is one big cricket ground and a jogging track. Hostel rent is affordable for students.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I suggest every student to study here.

All the basic amenities are present in the room, like table, fan, chair, beds, cupboard, etc. Hostel rooms have attached bathroom also. Mess food is tasty and delicious; they provide meals three times a day, and the menu is changed every four days. On hostel campus, there are 2 badminton court.
