reviews.review_heading: Nice experience here; true facts about my college.
reviews.review_text: In the hostel room, they provide a table, chair, B.Ed cupboard, fan, and other items. Cleaning staff come daily to clean the rooms, washrooms, and corridors. There is a big library in the hostel. The food provided is very delicious and healthy. Guards and CCTV cameras are present in the hostel for student security. There is one big cricket ground and a jogging track. Hostel rent is affordable for students.

reviews.review_heading: I suggest every student to study here.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure are nice and very beautiful. In first year, there are 2 accommodation room. Rooms are very big, spacious, and comfortable for 2 students. All the basic amenities are present in the room, like table, fan, chair, beds, cupboard, etc. Hostel rooms have attached bathroom also. Mess food is tasty and delicious; they provide meals three times a day, and the menu is changed every four days. On hostel campus, there are 2 badminton court.

reviews.review_heading: The overall college performance is great.
reviews.review_text: Hostels have strict rules and regulations for students. They will give leave only by getting permission from parents by phone call and receiving SMS from parents' mobile numbers. Hostel food is fine. But the same menu every week will get boring for students. PG hostel fees are 10,000 to 15,000, which is higher than in normal hostels. There are no ragging issues. A PG hostel has attached restroom facilities but a normal hostel has common restroom facilities.

reviews.review_heading: VICAS campus review by a student.
reviews.review_text: Hostels and foods are very good and healthy in nature. They provide a variety of food for a single day and they maintain very perfect infrastructure and hostel hygiene. The food-providing staff and other workers in the kitchen must wear gloves and chair nuts while cooking.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Vivekanandha College of Arts and Science For Women.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities were available on campus. Our college provided all the amenities to students. The quality of the food was normal. Medical facilities and college buses were available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and comfortable infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college has very good infrastructure in all other departments too. There are 4 to 5 separate hostels with numerous rooms with gym facilities, to learn extra curricular skills like car driving, typewriting institutes, and beauty parlor, etc. ,. Our college has very big library and also other libraries for specific departments. The campus is fully Wi-Fi provided campus.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college for women, and it's Asia's biggest college too.

Projectors are available for every class. A big library is available. The college is best for women's safety.
Classrooms are cleaned daily. There is drinking water on every floor of the buildings, and Wi-Fi is also available. Canteen foods are as hygiene-friendly as possible.

content.Placements: Approximately 50% of students were placed from our college if we take into consideration the last passed-out batch; the current last-year batch is yet to go under the interview round. paragraphs: HPU admission processis quite similar for most of the programmes. The differentiating point is only the selection criteria. For some courses, it is based on an entrance exam while for others, the selection is merit-based. Find below the step-wiseHimachal Pradesh University admission process:
STEP 1: HPU Application Process 2025

Candidates are required to fill out the application form online for most of the courses. The submission to the admission committee for BA, MA, MCom, and BCom programmes is offline. Aspirants also have to pay an application fee which is different for different courses.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

Once the candidates have made up their minds and registered for the course of their choice, they need to fulfil the selection requirements. For courses such as BTech, B.Ed, LLB, the university conducts anentrance exam.HPU MATis conducted for admission to the MBA programme. Admission to BA, MA, MCom and BCom courses, is based on merit in the last qualifying exam.
STEP 3: Merit List & Admission Confirmation

After the candidates are shortlisted, the university releases a merit list to announce the names of the selected candidates. The merit list is prepared based on the performance of the aspirants. Selected candidates are required to pay the course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by MCM DAV CollegeReviewed on 7 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Quality education, no placements, proper labs, good library, small campus.
reviews.review_text: Our department offers well-equipped labs. There are around six labs of Chemistry in our college. Classrooms are big and clean with blackboards, and the library is also good, containing every book I think. The library is open till 8 PM, and there’s an e-library.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Government College, SolanReviewed on 16 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Faculty is good, especially BBA's, but the main college faculty can find them quite rude.
reviews.review_text: The building that is provided for BBA is very much like a haunted house. People say it used to be a hostel building, and the classrooms are in better shape. The best thing is that there's a small balcony, and students can relax there. There's a problem with the washrooms too.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by NSCBM Government College, HamirpurReviewed on 23 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is an affordable government college, but placement opportunities are limited.
reviews.review_text: The college has 41 classrooms spread across its academic blocks. There are 17 UG labs, including 6 ICT-enabled labs, and 7 PG labs. The college also has 6 computer labs with a total of approximately 185 computers. There are separate hostels for boys and girls, each with a capacity of 90 students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Department of Evening Studies, Himachal Pradesh UniversityReviewed on 23 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Excellent learning environment with affordable, supportive teachers.
reviews.review_text: The B.Com classes are generally held in the University School of Social Sciences or the Management Block, sharing facilities with MBA/BBA students. Most MBA classrooms are gallery-style or set up to support case-study discussions. Dedicated computer labs with internet access are available for the IT/Operations practical.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Government College, NalagarhReviewed on 18 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Professors were amazing, helpful, polite, and recommended.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility was amazing. The charges were cheap and affordable. I recommended this course at Nalagarh College to juniors. The hostel was affordable and safe, especially for girls.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Government College, Reckong PeoReviewed on 18 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Government College, Reckong Peo.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of my course are well planned and designed, with all necessities available. The quality of all the facilities in my hostel is very good, and the food is fresh and tasty. Medical facilities and sports facilities are also available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by MMU Solan - Maharishi Markandeshwar UniversityReviewed on 8 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels have their own personal washrooms and its double sharing. There is no issue with electricity or water. It also has its own single beds. You can opt for a single room, but the fee doubles, you can also get a table, chair, and an almirah set for yourself from the college.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by University Institute of Technology, Himachal Pradesh UniversityReviewed on 5 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Attendance is the only good thing here.
reviews.review_text: Our college has poor infrastructure. There is no hostel facility despite being under HPU. The whole college is just one building with no campus. Labs and classrooms feel outdated, and facilities lag behind modern standards. However, I can say things are improving. The scenic location is a plus point, though.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Government College, DharamshalaReviewed on 4 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Government degree college, Dharamshala.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are very well planned, and all Wi-Fi labs, classrooms, and the Library are available for the course. The quality of the facilities in the hostel is also very good, and the food quality is high and fresh. All types of food are available. Medical facilities and sports facilities are also available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Government College, DharamshalaReviewed on 4 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Government college, dharamshala.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very good in my course. It has Wi-Fi, Labs, Classrooms, a Library, and other infrastructure required. The quality of the facilities in the hostel is average, and the food is very healthy and tasty in both mess and the canteen. The medical facilities and sports are also available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Government College, DharamshalaReviewed on 4 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: College life at Dharamshala college.
reviews.review_text: There are enough Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library for the B.A. course, and the quality of the facilities in my college is very good. Every food is available at the college mess and canteen. Medical facilities are also very good. Sports and games are also available for students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Government College, DharamshalaReviewed on 4 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: College life at GDC Dharmashala.
reviews.review_text: All facilities and infrastructure are available at my department, like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, etc. The quality of the facilities in my hostel is good. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen, Medical facilities, sports, and games are good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Himachal Dental CollegeReviewed on 2 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good faculty members and infrastructure, must consider for BDS MS.
reviews.review_text: It was quite below average. Campus was not so much big. Wi-Fi was also not there. There was no AC, only fans. Food was good. Games were available but only table tennis, badminton, and cricket. Canteen was there. The food quality was good. Library was quite nice where you could sit and enjoy studying, that's all.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Government College, KulluReviewed on 28 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Decent course content but no placements, good faculty, and limited campus activities.
reviews.review_text: The classroom condition is good in the science block. Labs are also in good condition. Wi-Fi is available on campus, but it's not working well. The canteen is also good, having cheap prices for food and serving good-quality food. The condition of the toilets is not good at this time.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Government Degree College, KangraReviewed on 27 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: My daily life at GDC Kangra.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and the infrastructure are very good and spacious. There are so many different classes, and the library is very clean. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is very good, and the food is very good and the college offers us very healthy and fresh food.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelors in Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Really good infrastructure and facilities.

review_content.Placements: Talking about last year, 80% of students were placed. The highest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 4 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA. Top recruiters are Wipro and TCS. 75% of students also got internships in B.Com. Top role offered from my knowledge is a manager in a company or a finance analyst.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is also a reason to attract students apart from the regular classes. They also organise a program by which one's skills are enhanced. Classrooms are well maintained and library has all the books needed. I am also living in the hostel. You can surely live here with zero tension. If you are a Bengali, you will love the food they give.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Food and Nutrition - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the college .

review_content.Placements: Our college provides the best placement. I'm in first year but most of the senior students get placement in good companies. The college is very supportive in this matter. Placement from Mio-more, Frankross, Nestle, Amul and many top companies are present.
review_content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are big and airy. The library has a huge collection of books which we use for taking notes. We regularly have lab classes with proper guidance from the teachers. The hostel is cleaned regularly and the food from the canteen is affordable and hygienic.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Food and Nutrition - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, our college campus is suitable for all type of educational purposes.

review_content.Placements: 90% of the students are placed in this course. There are numerous companies including Apollo Hospital and Genesis Hospital. More than 80% of students secured internships. Companies like Amul, Mother Dairy, and hospitals like Apollo, among others, also offer excellent placement opportunities.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is nice, the rooms are airy, and there is a Wi-Fi network available. The library, labs, and classrooms are all spacious. Excellent hostel and mess quality. The food is of good quality and is readily available.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Food and Nutrition - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Kingston College of Science is one of the best college in Kolkata.

review_content.Placements: 60% of students got placed. Companies like Keventer, Amul, Raja Biscuits, and Kwality Walls visit to recruit students. Dietician, nutritionist, factory organizer, and food scientist are roles offered. Food and nutrition is a great subject, there is a great scope and opportunity by studying the subject all over the world. You can also shift abroad by studying the subject.
review_content.Infrastructure: Every facility is available is available. Our hostel is really cool and the other boys are very cooperative, helpful, and civil. The hostel provides best quality food. The overall environment and infrastructure of the hostel is great. Overall the campus is decent.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Microbiology - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Well-qualified teachers and ample scholarship opportunities available.

review_content.Placements: I am still in the first year of my college and not placed yet but I have seen my seniors got placed in reputed labs and companies. Top recruiting companies of our college are Mother Dairy and Dr. Lal Path Labs. Among my seniors, 70% of them got placed.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is good. There are facilities like Wi-Fi are available. Labs are well maintained and the library has a good collection of books. There is a huge playground and a playing facility is there. College has separate hostels for boys and girls and the food of the canteen is good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Microbiology - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Best private college for science field in West Bengal.

review_content.Placements: The placements of Kingston College of Science are pretty good. Most students get average package and are very happy. The college is very supportive in this matter. Almost every student gets a placement and is happy with it.

individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Talking about last year, 80% of students were placed. The highest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 4 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA. If you are a Bengali, you will love the food they give.

individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the college .

paragraphs: Sunrise University admissionsare merit-based. The university conducts an entrance test for admission to PhD courses.Sunrise Universityoffers varied undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral-level programs in the fields of Teaching and education, Mass Communication and Media, Medicine and Health Sciences, Business and Management Studies, Arts, Engineering, Law, Commerce, and IT and software.

The university offers admission to candidates considering their merit in the last qualifying exam. Besides, aspirants applying for PhD have to pass the entrance exam conducted by the university. Below areSunrise University coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Sunrise admission criteria is a multi-step procedure. Candidates seeking admission can refer to the steps mentioned below to understand theSunrise University admission process:
STEP 1: Sunrise University Application Process 2025
To apply for admission to University, candidates need to fill out the online application form available on the university's website. They can also download or collect the form from the campus.
STEP 2: Selection

The university evaluates the applications of the candidates for educational qualification. The merit of the candidate's in the previous qualifying exam is considered for admission. For PhD, the university conducts an entrance test.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation

After the candidates submit their applications, the university reviews them and makes an admission decision. They are informed of the decision via email or the university website. Further, aspirants have to pay theSunrise University feeto confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: How can I get a job after completing BA?
faqs.answer: You'll have countless career options after your BA, so here's the list: Giving government exams i.e. giving UPSC, SSC and Banking exam. Pursuing a career in law field- It'll take another 3 years. Fashion/Interior Designing- I do not have much knowledge about how to go about this, but you can definitely go with this Translator- French, German, Spanish and what not are available for BA. You just need to select the correct college which offers you different languages. Psychologist- Sadly, this option is only open if you've taken psychology as your major. Economist- Again, if you opted for economics as a major in BA. But I have a few friends who aspire to become economists. Historian- Same thing again. Journalist- Currently, electronic media is everything. Film Industry- We all know that Bollywood is not all about actors. You have a lot of people working. There are directors, makeup artists, editors, etc. You can join the sales department of a firm. You can also pursue MBA and get a good job.

faqs.question: What are the career options available after completing a BCom degree course?
faqs.answer: BCom course is the gateway to job opportunities in several fields such as Accounting, Finance, Economics, Taxation, Insurance, etc. One can become an Accountant, Financial Analyst, Auditor, etc. after graduating with a BCom degree. This degree is also beneficial to those students who want to run their own businesses. Because of the variety of work prospects it gives, BCom is one of the most popular undergraduate educational programmes. Commerce is the nation's most important industry, and it has a huge impact on the economy. The expanding economy has resulted in a variety of job opportunities in the business sector. As a result, a Bachelor of Commerce degree can lead to a lucrative career.

faqs.question: What is the average salary after pursuing D Pharmacy course?
faqs.answer: Most organizations can offer a pay scale for DPharm fresh graduates from INR 3 Lacs to INR 4 lakh per annum. Initially, new joiner will keep training or probation position, after which their pay scale would be revised. Post that new employees can find a salary in range of INR 5 Lacs - INR 7 Lacs. After gaining experience or higher education qualifications, a person can become a Pharmaceutical Executive or Laboratory Scientist whereby their salary would be in range of INR 7 Lacs - INR 9 lakh. reviews.review_heading: Foundation of your future.
reviews.review_text:

.

reviews.review_heading: University is good and campus is green.

reviews.review_heading: Review for B.Com doing college of Sunrise University .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is huge and the central library is available with the good books. All the facilities like Wi-Fi connection, laboratory, grounds and annual fest available in our campus. Quality of the food our canteen is also hygienic and having variety.

reviews.review_heading: College and faculty members are good, and it is worth for getting admission.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are available for all courses. Classrooms are well-established, and the library has one of the best collections in Alwar. Quality of the hostel is very good, and they provide good food and accommodation. They also provide medical facilities for students.

reviews.review_heading: Sunrise University Alwar is located in a village which is 20 km away from Alwar city.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi service was available, and we also had highly constructed practical labs. The mess served different types of food like rice, roti and dal. The food menu changed every week. The environment on the campus was good t live. Every year, games and events were held.

reviews.review_heading: The staff members were good during our course duration, i.e., from the academic year 2014-2017.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college was average. Wi-Fi facility was not available. Commerce students don't need a lab. The canteen was also good and had a stationery shop in it. The medical facility provided was also good, and the university had a large playground with lots of sports equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Overall for study this university is very good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of this university is very big with a ground. The Wi-Fi medical and sports facilities is very amazing they also have a big classrooms. Library is also there with many books the quality of classrooms and labs are very nice, food quality is not so good but they have a huge range. Hostel rooms is okay.

reviews.review_heading: A good college to learn and improve your skills in any field a person wants to grow his/her career.
reviews.review_text: We were provided with good facilities. Labs, classrooms, library and all facilities are upto date with projectors in every classroom. We have a canteen which provides good quality food for every student and faculty members. Sports and games classes were provided to all the students including the faculty members.

reviews.review_heading: Average college because of the type of placements offered.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi networks are available for most of the times in college. The college classroom are spacious but air flow or ventilation is low. The sports field is available and sports equipment are also available. First aid kit is available in the college. Certain insurance policy is available for the students of college.

reviews.review_heading: The college has helpful faculty and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the university is good. Every classroom is spacious. The garden of college is greenery with different plants as well as with trees. You can also get labs facilities in college. There were different labs for each subject. About medical and sports facilities, the university has medical rooms for the students for an emergency like kits and all.

reviews.review_heading: This university admission for only accepts money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is out of the area in Alwar district. Nobody lives here. There are farmers only. There is no transport that can reach the college. There is no other education department in that area. So can't take admission in the university. Sunrise university is fake.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and students and staffs.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college very minimalistic and vibrant Wi-Fi networks are everywhere in college. There is big ground in the entrance back side is playing field. Food quality of canteen was good and hostel rooms were very good maintenance we didn't face any issues while residing in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: If you are in Alwar, then this is the place to go.
reviews.review_text: There is no on-campus Wi-Fi facility for the students. There are various labs on the campus as per the requirements of the courses being offered by the college. The college provides the medical facilities and sports as well. The labs are fully equipped, but only 20% of the classes have the projectors installed. The food quality is good, but only limited variety is kept. I have never been in the hostel.

The duration of the UG-level programme is three years, further divided in to six semesters. Admission to the programme is subject to fulfilment of the preset eligibility and selection criteria. The university offers 200 seats under its BCom programme. For more information, candidates must visit the university's official website.

faqs.question: How are MBA placements at Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee University?
faqs.answer: The placement scenario for MBA students at Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee University might vary based on several factors, including industry demand, economic conditions, and the performance of students. Generally, MBA placements at this university might exhibit a mixed trend, with some students securing promising job opportunities while others may need to make more effort in their job search. The university's placement cell often plays a pivotal role in facilitating placements by organizing campus recruitment drives, inviting companies from diverse sectors to conduct placement sessions, and providing career guidance and support to students.DSPMU attracts various companies to its campus placement drives, including Infosys, Wipro, ICICI Bank, TCS, Cisco, Tech Mahindra, and others. This offers students opportunities to secure jobs in reputable organizations. While official data for 2023 placements isn't yet available, recent reviews suggest a placement rate around 30-35% for the MBA program. This might seem lower compared to some top institutes, but it's important to consider the university's location and regional context. The university emphasizes enhancing employability skills through workshops, seminars, and industry interactions. This helps prepare students for interviews and the corporate world. DSPMU boasts a strong alumni network, which can be valuable for securing mentorship, internships, and job opportunities. The average salary package offered to DSPMU MBA graduates is reported to be around INR 2-3 Lakhs per annum. This could be considered modest compared to other MBA programs, especially in metropolitan cities.
